name: A family keepsake
description: Milena lost her suitcase near the Living District bus stop. Keep the other contents, but return her treasured family photo for an Athletics magazine.
offerText: Have you seen my suitcase near the bus stop?

stages.description: Find Milena's family photo in the suitcase near the Living District bus stop.
Return the family photo to Milena Vukovic.
